final: WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS customer_total FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId), overall AS (SELECT SUM(customer_total) AS overall_sum FROM customer_totals), shares AS (SELECT c.CustomerId, c.customer_total, c.customer_total * 1.0 / o.overall_sum AS share FROM customer_totals AS c CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_sum IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(s.customer_total), AVG(s.share), AVG(s.share - a.mean_share) FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE a.mean_share IS NOT NULL AND s.share > a.mean_share
